items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Mosley Interview, 1961-09-23
items.q: Well, he was a good friend of mine.

ctx.x: Oh, I was going to say, speaking of church, sorry I missed one of the Matthews brothers that played at church. Which one was that? Oh, yeah, he did. Yeah, Remus.
Remus Matthews, yeah. Well, he was a good friend of mine. Yeah. All of them used to play together. Where did they live?
Near this neighborhood? Never heard of him.
